subject: Re: BridgeHouse Accelerator — stipend & sponsor package
body:
From: Ava Lang <coordinator@bridgehouse.org>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BridgeHouse Accelerator — stipend and sponsor package?

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the cohort team was impressed with Redwood's latency and the KV cache savings on our sample workload. Two quick asks as we firm up the sponsorship package for the August cohort: 

1) We typically provide a small stipend to each founding team to offset cloud costs. Can Redwood extend a $3k usage stipend (one-time credit per team) to 12 teams in the cohort?
2) For teams that convert to paid later, BridgeHouse asks sponsors to offer a short-term preferential committed rate (6 months) keyed to cohort attendees — typically 20% off list for the first 6 months with the option to convert to standard reservations after.

We have a tight timeline for the sponsorship deck (final deck Monday) so any guidance on feasibility + a one-line terms summary we can put into the deck would be super helpful. Also, if there are required legal steps (SOW or invoice instructions), flag them and we will loop legal.

Appreciate it — Ava
BridgeHouse Accelerator
Attachment: BridgeHouse_Sponsorship_Deck_v4.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB)

-----
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Ava Lang <coordinator@bridgehouse.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeHouse Accelerator — stipend and sponsor package?

Hi Ava — great to hear the demo landed well. Short answers below and a few notes for your deck: 

- Stipend: We can provide a $3,000 Redwood usage stipend to up to 12 teams (total program stipend pool: $36,000). These are one-time hosted API credits redeemable within 12 months of issuance.
- Preferential rate: We can offer a 20% discount off list pricing for up to 6 months for teams that convert to paid accounts within 90 days of the cohort start. The discount applies to usage (hosted API) only; it does not apply to Dedicated reservations or private deployment fees.

Terms to include in your deck (one line): "Redwood Inference provides a $3k usage stipend per team (12 teams) and a limited 20% off hosted-API promotional rate for 6 months on teams that convert post-cohort; credits valid 12 months; discount excludes Dedicated/Private contracts; standard T&Cs apply."

We will need a short SOW and a list of participating teams (names + emails) to issue the credits. Legal will want to sign a simple promotional SOW; I can share a template. Attaching a quick summary spreadsheet for your procurement team.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment: promo_terms_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)

-----
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BridgeHouse Accelerator — stipend & sponsor package (approval request)

Team — forwarding BridgeHouse's ask and the terms I proposed above. Quick context: BridgeHouse is a high-touch regional accelerator with strong startup alumni (several later-stage logos). This is a sponsorship relationship where we issue credits to teams and get co-marketing + pilot introductions in return.

Proposal I put in the deck: $3k stipend x 12 teams (credits redeemable within 12 months) + 20% off hosted-API usage for 6 months for converting teams. No discount for Dedicated or Private.

Questions for leadership/sales ops: 
- Approve $36k program stipend and 20% promotional rate for converting startups?
- Any guardrails we should attach (max usage per team, anti-abuse, clawback language)?
- Procurement/legal: do we push a simple SOW + redemption form and require team contact info up front?

I can accept on behalf of Sales if leadership signs off; BridgeHouse needs a one-line terms blurb for the deck by Monday morning.

Thanks — V

-----
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: BridgeHouse Accelerator — stipend & sponsor package (approval request)

Vanessa — I discussed with Marissa and Legal. We can approve the program with the following conditions: 

1) Cap per-team redemptions at $3k (as you proposed) and require each team to register with a verified email + intent form.
2) Set an aggregate program cap of $36,000 and include an anti-abuse clause: credits are one-time, non-transferable, and we reserve the right to revoke on suspicious usage.
3) The 20% promotional rate is approved for hosted API only and limited to teams that provide proof of conversion (invoice or billing activation) within 90 days. It should default back to standard pricing after 6 months.
4) Sales must collect participant list before credits are issued; Legal will issue a short promotional SOW (template attached) and procurement needs to issue an invoice for the sponsorship pool if BridgeHouse wants Redwood to invoice them directly.

Marissa will share the SOW template and procurement flow; Lauren, loop me if there are billing constraints. Vanessa — you can tell BridgeHouse to include the one-line summary in the deck. We'll get Legal to send the SOW to BridgeHouse Legal once we have the list.

Approved — Rishi

Attachments mentioned: promotional_SOW_template.docx (to be sent by legal)
